mainEntity.name: What are the investment options for the Golden Visa?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Golden Visa offers various investment options, including real estate investment, business setup and ownership, investment in public investments, and certain specialized fields such as scientific research, technology, and art.

mainEntity.name: Can Golden Visa holders travel freely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Golden Visa holders enjoy freedom of movement within the UAE and can travel in and out of the country without the need for additional visas.

mainEntity.name: What are the requirements to apply for the Golden Visa?

acceptedAnswer.text: The specific requirements for the Golden Visa depend on the category of the applicant. Generally, applicants need to meet certain investment thresholds, have a clean criminal record, demonstrate relevant experience or expertise, and fulfill any additional criteria set by the UAE authorities.
